messages:
Elaine - PM: Quick sync — AcmePay asked for per-tenant route overrides so they can pin critical payments traffic to a low-latency model. They want a staged rollout + SLA. Need agreement on scope we ship first (full override vs read-only config), canary plan, and launch criteria. Thoughts? :eyes:
Aj - Eng: I think two-phase works: config + routing read-only first (no write UI), shadow against production, then percent-based canary. Implementation is a feature flag tied to tenant id.
Samir - SRE: Agree on shadow first. Also need hard fallback policy: if p95 latency for tenant > 400ms OR error_rate > 1.5% for 3m, automatically route to default model variant + alert on-call. Capacity question: dedicated pool or use existing shards?
Maria - Solutions: AcmePay will require dedicated capacity for their SLA, but we can negotiate starting with regional restriction (US-only) to reduce scope. They also asked for an opt-in testing tenant. We should offer a staging tenant on Dedicated.
Jessica - CS: They expect 99.9 uptime and low tail latency. We should push them to accept an initial limited scope: routing overrides for payment endpoints only, not for all product pages. That lowers blast radius and makes the SLA discussion easier.
Aj - Eng: For rollout flags I propose config like:
```
feature: per_tenant_route_override
state: shadow | gradual | enabled | disabled
rules:
  - tenant: acmepay
    endpoints: ["/v1/payments", "/v1/invoices"]
    rollout: 0.01  # start at 1%
```
Keep it simple so ops can change rollout % without deploy.
Samir - SRE: +1. Also add a circuit-breaker policy: if p95 > 400ms for tenant for 3 consecutive 1m windows -> divert X% (start 50%) to default model and escalate. If divert rate persists > 10m, auto-scale or roll back.
Elaine - PM: Let's codify launch gates: (1) shadow run for 48h with zero errors attributable to overrides, (2) canary at 1% for 4h with p95 < 400ms and error_rate < 0.5%, (3) 10% for 24h with business metrics sanity check, (4) full enable. Approve?
Aj - Eng: Need to add safety net for config collisions: only one active override per tenant per endpoint. Also we should support an immediate kill-switch (flag=false) at org level.
Maria - Solutions: For customer acceptance test (CAT) we can provide a simple test harness: synthetic traces that simulate heavy payment flows + sample payloads. We'll run with them during the 10% window.
Jessica - CS: I'll draft negotiation language: commit to phased enablement + dedicated pool option. If they insist on full region, require a 3-month dedicated contract.
Samir - SRE: Telemetry we track (per-tenant): p50/p95/p99 latency, request concurrency, error_rate, fallback_rate, routing_diversion_rate, cpu/mem on serving hosts. Alert thresholds: error_rate > 1% or p95 > 400ms triggers P1 page.
Elaine - PM: Ops/Runbook items: add a per-tenant dashboard tile, expose rollout % in Console (ops toggle), and add an automated on-call message + runbook link. Who owns these?
Aj - Eng: Eng owns console toggle + backend flag. Samir owns alerting and runbook. Maria will own customer CAT coordination. Jessica will own contract language.
deploy-bot: Canaries deployed: per_tenant_route_override acmepay rollout=0.01 -> shadow->canary pipeline started (build 789, infra 302). :rocket:
Elaine - PM: Nice. Next steps: Aj create PR with config schema + kill-switch by EOD Wed, Samir draft runbook and alert pages by Thu, Maria schedule CAT with AcmePay for next Tue. Jessica will send draft contract. I'll follow up with weekly checkpoints. :calendar:
Aj - Eng: Working on the PR now, will include sample API for operators to change rollout % via Console API.
Samir - SRE: I'll stub an automated fallback policy in SLO service; need a test tenant to validate.
Maria - Solutions: I'll share the synthetic trace spec in #product-docs once it's cleaned up.
Elaine - PM: Great. If anything changes, ping me. Otherwise we convene Thu to sign off on runbook and metrics. :thumbsup:
